name: Hierarchical Volume Rendering for Cloud Surface
definition: A rendering method for cloud surfaces where the diffusion approximation is invalid, using hierarchical volume rendering with opacities ρ(X)σt and voxel colors I0(X).
summary: Hierarchical Volume Rendering for Cloud Surface renders cloud edges where diffusion fails by using view-dependent octree selection based on least-squares approximations and hardware cell-projection compositing.
